text: Growing up I had one hot take.
I would not shut up about.
Ms. Dhoni is the greatest of all time and every adult told me that the same thing
you will grow out of it.
Look who else was playing back then, Jack, Kelly, Shane, Juan, Mutha, Yamuli, Darin, Rahul, Ravid, Bran, Lara, Delston and Ricky Ponting. 2 World Cup
Every one of them could walk into any all-time 11.
I watched every one of them. I went through every record. I really tried to change my mind and now I can finally tell you something.
I did not grow out of it.
First tournament as captain he wins the t20 world cup then he takes the India to the number 1 in test cricket 2011 World Cup final 91 not out and he finishes off in style

2013 the champions trophy date makes him the only captor in history to win all 3 ICC wide world trophies. 5 IPEL titles as captors, the most dumping in the international cricket. The most note out in ODI history because when Dhoni is out there the match is not over yet. So no, I never grow out of it. MS Dhoni is the greatest of all time. I said it back then, I am saying it now.
Who was your childhood girl? Tell me in the comments.
